source_title: Council Poll Defeat, Apology To Supreme Court And Opposition Agitation Plans Under Fire - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
A ruling party address highlighted the recent legislative council elections conducted through ballot papers and ballot boxes, stating that the opposition party failed to secure voter backing. The address maintained that electoral difficulties stem not from electronic voting machines, voter lists, or ballot papers, but from internal disarray and a reluctance to work among the electorate. Attention was also drawn to party leaders travelling overseas during critical periods instead of engaging in sustained public outreach. Furthermore, the opposition state unit in Kerala tendered an unconditional apology following an objectionable social media post concerning the Chief Justice of India. The address noted earlier instances involving edited videos of the Union Home Minister during parliamentary polls to assert a pattern of confronting constitutional bodies. Referring to past apologies tendered before the highest court, the address questioned the accountability of the opposition leadership regarding persistent attacks on constitutional institutions.
